newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Ten-year-old raped in Bogota hospital.
newsitem.headline: Ten-year-old raped in Bogota hospital.

text.p: A 10-year-old girl was raped in a state-run hospital in the Colombian capital after being heavily sedated and left in a state of coma, local media reported on Thursday.
Bogota's El Espectador newspaper said a nurse's aide was the leading suspect in the case, which occurred on Sunday at the city's El Tunal hospital.
The victim had been brought to the hospital by her parents for treatment of an infection stemming from minor surgery a few days earlier, the daily said.
It said she had been drugged with a powerful sedative used to treat psychiatric patients and remained unconscious as of late Wednesday.
Hospital officials could not be reached for immediate comment but authorities said no arrest had been made in the case.
In another Bogota rape case, two women were sexually abused by a band of thieves who robbed 15 passengers aboard a city bus on Tuesday night.
The eight stick-up men terrorised the passengers with machetes, knives and pistols during a 2 1/2-hour "joy ride" across the city, police spokesmen said. They said no arrests had been made yet.
